title: Embedded scalar restriction reflects completeness
statement: For the embedded coefficient maps of [def-sfb-embedded-integral-model-coefficients], restriction of any unbounded continuous integral derived complex is complete over constant coefficients if and only if the original complex is complete over continuous coefficients. Assume ell prime, E finite embedded, pi generates its maximal ideal, and X Noetherian.

proof.text: Use the ambient coefficient presentation and the lifted principal uniformizer ideal.

The Koszul quotient reflector characterizes both completeness conditions by their completion units; completion_restriction intertwines those units. Derived scalar restriction reflects isomorphisms, so cancel the invertible comparison. Transport back using isomorphism invariance of the slice internal-Hom vanishing tests.

theorem embeddedIntegral_complete_iff
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ)
    (π : PadicAlgCl.integers ℓ E.1)
    (hπ : Ideal.span {π} = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (PadicAlgCl.integers ℓ E.1))
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X]
    (K : DerivedCategory.{u + 1} (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
      (integralCoefficientObject X ℓ E))) :
    IntegralModelsEmbedded.constantComplete ℓ E π X
      ((IntegralModelsEmbedded.restriction ℓ E X).obj K) ↔
      IntegralModelsEmbedded.completedComplete ℓ E π X K
